params.prompt: Educational reference diagram, clean black line art on white. Title at top: "Anchor Scale to a TALL Object". TWO panels side by side. LEFT panel headed "SHORT ANCHOR — fails" with a red X: a small cartoon creature standing beside a knee-high side table, drawn TWICE — once correctly small, and once ghosted at roughly double the size, with a curved arrow showing it drifting larger. Caption: "a low object reads as a floor, not a ceiling". RIGHT panel headed "TALL ANCHOR — holds" with a green check: the same creature beside a tall floor-to-ceiling shelving unit, with a dotted horizontal measure line showing the creature reaching only one quarter of the way up the shelf, and a human silhouette beside it for scale. Caption: "a tall object gives a ratio that cannot be misread". Footer: "Name a tall fixture, state a fraction of its height, and add a human yardstick.". No other text.
